create.name: Sifu Scott Jensen
create.bio:
Sifu Scott Jensen is a teacher of classical Chinese martial arts, Tai Chi and Qigong, with more than forty years of training and teaching. His main teacher was Grandmaster Wong Jackman, with whom he studied for some 25 years and from whom he inherited Northern Shaolin, Yang-family Tai Chi Chuan and Xingyi Quan; his Northern Shaolin lineage runs back through Yan Shangwu to Gu Ruzhang. He has also studied Tai Chi with senior representatives of the Chen and Yang families, as well as Bagua Zhang and Lan Shou Quan, and won a gold medal for Tai Chi at the internal martial arts championships at Wudang Mountain in China.

In 2006 he founded 10,000 Victories, a school in San Rafael, California, where he teaches weekly Qigong, Tai Chi and Kung Fu classes with an emphasis on posture, breath, structure and Wude, or martial virtue. An online platform of more than 700 lessons follows the same step-by-step curriculum for home practice. He hosts the podcast Ancient Wisdom, Modern Health, co-wrote Qigong for Health with Rachel Jensen, and teaches longer Qigong trainings on The Shift Network.

books.title: Qigong for Health: A Guide for New Students
books.author: Scott Jensen, Rachel Jensen
books.description: An illustrated beginner's guide to Qigong, co-written with Rachel Jensen. It explains what Qigong is, its main types and goals, the foundation theories, and how to begin with breathing and concentration practice.

courses.title: 10,000 Victories Online Training
courses.description: A membership library of more than 700 lessons in Tai Chi, Qigong and classical Kung Fu, arranged as progressive pathways that follow the school's in-person curriculum. Starts with a 7-day free trial.
courses.price: $48 USD per month or $517 USD per year

courses.title: Tai Chi & Qigong Classes in San Rafael
courses.description: Weekly in-person classes in Qigong, Yang-family Tai Chi, Tai Chi sword and Kung Fu at the San Rafael Community Center, California. Classes are paid by session, with combination options.

free_resources.title: Ancient Wisdom, Modern Health podcast
free_resources.description: Free podcast episodes in which Sifu Jensen talks about Qi, Qigong, the Three Treasures, martial virtue and the lore of the Chinese martial arts. A good introduction to the ideas behind his teaching.

flags: Name kept as 'Sifu Scott Jensen' because the honorific is how he is known (Shift, his own site); slug drops it.
The YouTube, Instagram and Facebook accounts are the school's (10,000 Victories) rather than personal; he is the founder and head instructor and appears throughout.

The Six Stages of Qi Mastery started on 12 Aug 2026 and ends 16 Dec 2026; kept with dates because late registration is open, but drop it if only not-yet-started courses should be listed. Its sales page carries pain-related testimonials; title and my description are clean.
Book title 'Qigong for Health' and its blurb ('how to start if your health is weak', 'Start Healing!') are borderline; no condition is named, so it was kept.
The email address is published with a capital V (practice@10000Victories.com); emails are case-insensitive.
The San Rafael class price is a range across class types as published; a 'Dr. Scott Jensen' (Minnesota politician) appears in YouTube searches and is a different person.
left_out: Shift course Supercharge Your Blood With the Power of Qi: its page claims to help arthritis, chronic fatigue, Parkinson's, blood pressure, immunity and pain.

Videos 'Proper Pelvic Position Prevents Pain', 'Build Your Strength, Alleviate Aches and Pains with Yi Jin Jing', 'From Trauma to Recovery', 'Healing Miracle of Tai Chi' and 'Qigong Mysticism vs. Western Medical Science': health or medical framing.
Short clips under ~2 minutes, form demonstrations, tournament and celebration clips, course promos, and performance videos on other channels.
Kung Fu Animal Power Fu children's books (Jensen with Rachel Jensen and Darcy Calhoun): children's martial-arts books, not spiritual teaching; Northern Shaolin Special Report not found on Amazon.
Xingyi Quan Twelve Animal Sparring seminar series (Aug 2026–Jan 2027, already under way) and corporate wellness programmes: martial or corporate, and dated.
Private lessons and seminar series: not his main way of working; prices not published.
Goodreads / World of Books not checked.
1 dated offering(s) that had already started by 2026-10-30
